dedupe_keys.name: estimation of required collector forces in special reinforced concrete moment frames from target yield mechanisms

description: Estimation of Required Collector Forces in Special Reinforced Concrete Moment Frames from Target Yield Mechanisms is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Cesar Ortiz, University of Texas at Arlington (uta.edu). This dataset contains the supplementary materials referenced in the manuscript, “Estimation of Required Collector Forces in Concrete Moment Frames via Target Yield Mechanisms.” The dataset was developed to evaluate a mechanics-based procedure for deriving diaphragm collector demands from the probable plastic strengths associated with an assumed target yield mechanism. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project with 1 top-level file (PDF). Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-k3mn-3652. Keywords: collector forces, target yield mechanisms, moment frames. Published 2026-09-08. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
